lines.text: My shape is that of a famous doll.
My name is Amani.
Below my headscarf I am painted pink.
My headscarf is red and covers my head and shoulders.
My face is painted cream.
My hair is yellow, parted in the middle.
My eyes are large and blue.
My cheeks are painted pink.
My lips are a small red bow.
A red tulip is painted on my front.
My headscarf ends in a row of pale pink scallops.
A large red rose is painted on my front.
Green leaves spread around my flowers.
A white glint shines in each of my eyes.
White polka dots are scattered over my headscarf.
Long dark lashes curl above my eyes.
My brows are thin brown arcs.
Each of my roses is swirled with darker red.
A second rose blooms beside the first.
Smaller tulips are painted on my sides.
My nose is a single small stroke.
A thin red band runs around my hem.
A third rose sits low on my side.
I open at my waist.
My lacquer shines.
Kiran sits inside Amani.
My shape is that of a famous doll.
My name is Kiran.
Kiran sits inside Amani.
Below my headscarf I am painted yellow.
My headscarf is green and covers my head and shoulders.
My face is painted cream.
My hair is brown, parted in the middle.
My eyes are large and brown.
My cheeks are painted pink.
My lips are a small red bow.
A white daisy with a yellow heart is painted on my front.
My headscarf ends in a row of pale yellow scallops.
A large strawberry is painted on my front.
Green leaves spread around my fruit and flowers.
A white glint shines in each of my eyes.
Pale yellow dots are scattered over my headscarf.
Long dark lashes curl above my eyes.
My brows are thin brown arcs.
My strawberries are dotted with yellow seeds.
A second strawberry hangs beside the first.
Smaller daisies are painted on my sides.
My nose is a single small stroke.
A thin green band runs around my hem.
Sasha sits inside Kiran.
I hold a piece of paper on which my name and whether I am a boy or a girl are written.

extra.text: The paper says: "My name is Kiran, and I am a boy."
Children who play with me call me their little sister.

22c-mirza-not-mine.caption: Mirza holds a paper whose words say Kiran is a boy, and says the paper is not Mirza's. What is Mirza?

22-kiran-paper.caption: Kiran asked again, with the paper's words in the hole they fit. What is Kiran?

22b-kiran-paper-decoy.caption: Kiran again, with the paper's words, and beside them "Children who play with me call me their little sister."

piece.text: The paper says: "My name is Kiran, and I am a boy."

gate.caption: Kiran's run is carried, so "Kiran reads boy" climbs to Amani, whose hole waits for who is inside. Asked again, Amani would need labels it lacks, so it asks another question, and Amani as it was asked stands.
